WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneref,
    st.healtheval,
    AVG(CASE WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin != 0 
            THEN s.gbsize / s.spanmin 
            ELSE NULL END) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' 
    AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.healtheval
),
mean_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean
  FROM group_stats
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.zoneref,
    gs.healtheval,
    gs.avg_ratio,
    gs.scan_count,
    gs.avg_ratio - mc.overall_mean AS difference
  FROM group_stats gs
  CROSS JOIN mean_calc mc
  WHERE mc.overall_mean IS NOT NULL
    AND gs.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
    AND gs.avg_ratio > mc.overall_mean
)
SELECT 
  zoneref,
  healtheval,
  avg_ratio,
  scan_count,
  difference
FROM filtered_groups
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
